fields.name: Interface views
fields.description:
These CDS views are designed for the purpose
of reading data.

fields.name: Transactional processing views
fields.description:
These CDS views are mainly designed to not only expose data for reading, but to
enable actions such as creating, changing, or deleting
instances of a RAP business object in the context of the
ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP). For more
information about RAP, see ABAP RESTful Application
Programming Model.

fields.name: Remote API views
fields.description:
These CDS views are designed to form the basis for
external APIs. For more information about APIs, see APIs on SAP Business Accelerator Hub.

fields.name: View extends
fields.description:
These CDS views can read data only indirectly in the
context of another CDS view. View extends typically provide
access to industry-specific or country/region-specific
fields defined by SAP.

fields.name: Extension include views
fields.description:
These CDS views can read data only indirectly in the
context of another CDS view. Extension include views provide
access to custom fields created in the Custom Fields app.
For more information, see Custom Fields.

fields.name: Derivation functions
fields.description:
Derivation functions derive context-specific values that can be used to restrict data in analytical
queries. For more information, see Derivation Functions for Finance.

fields.name: SQL_DATA_SOURCE
fields.description:
Can be used as a data source in a SQL SELECT statement, for example,
in an ABAP program.

fields.name: CDS_MODELING_DATA_SOURCE
fields.description: Can be used as a data source when defining a new CDS entity.

fields.name: CDS_MODELING_ASSOCIATION_TARGET
fields.description: Can be used as an association target when defining a new CDS entity.

fields.name: DATA_STRUCTURE
fields.description: Defines a data structure and can't be used for other purposes, such as retrieving data.

fields.name: LANGUAGE_DEPENDENT_TEXT
fields.description: Functions as a text view that contains language-dependent text for another CDS entity.

fields.name: VALUE_HELP_PROVIDER
fields.description: Provides value help for a field in another CDS entity.

fields.name: EXTRACTION_DATA_SOURCE
fields.description:
Can be used for data extraction to a cloud service or another system, for example, remote applications or data
warehouses.

fields.name: DERIVATION_FUNCTION
fields.description:
Derivation functions are a specific class of CDS views that are used to find default values for user input
fields, for example, in analytics. For example, a derivation function can determine the previous months as a date
interval from the current date, which is used in a standard report.

fields.name: PARENT_CHILD_HIERARCHY_NODE_PROVIDER
fields.description:
Defines a parent-child hierarchy. Requests return hierarchy nodes with additional hierarchy-specific
information, for example the size of the subhierarchy starting at a node. It can be used in hierarchy-navigation
and hierarchy-aggregation functions.

fields.name: SEARCHABLE_ENTITY
fields.description: Can be used for searching with the HANA search functionality. For more information, see Search.

fields.name: ANALYTICAL_QUERY
fields.description: Can be used as an analytical query in different analytics front ends, such as SAP Analytics Cloud.

fields.name: ANALYTICAL_CUBE
fields.description:
Can be used as an analytical cube. A CDS view with this modeling pattern usually has the supported capability
Data Provider for Analytical Queries.

fields.name: ANALYTICAL_DIMENSION
fields.description: Can be used as a dimension in an analytical cube.

fields.name: ANALYTICAL_PROVIDER
fields.description: Can be used as analytical provider (primary data source) for an analytical query.

fields.name: ANALYTICAL_PARENT_CHILD_HIERARCHY_NODE
fields.description:
Can be used as a parent-child hierarchy in analytics. It’s either an analytical dimension, or connected to an
analytical dimension. The rows of the entity represent nodes of the hierarchy.

fields.name: OUTPUT_FORM_DATA_PROVIDER
fields.description: Can be used as a data source for form templates.

fields.name: OUTPUT_EMAIL_DATA_PROVIDER
fields.description: Can be used as a data source for email templates.

fields.name: OUTPUT_PARAMETER_DETERMINATION_DATA_SOURCE
fields.description: Can be used as a data provider for the determination of parameters.

fields.name: SITUATION_ANCHOR
fields.description:
Instance of a business object for which a situation is displayed. For example, a purchase requisition for which
a new purchase contract is available.

fields.name: SITUATION_TRIGGER
fields.description:
Instance of a business object that triggers an object-based situation. For example, a new purchase contract
that is available for open purchase requisitions.

fields.name: SITUATION_DATACONTEXT
fields.description:
Data associated with a business situation that can be collected, exported, and used for advanced
analytics.

fields.name: NONE
fields.description:
Used if there’s no specific modeling pattern for the CDS view. Often CDS views with this modeling pattern are
auxiliary views and can, for example, be used as a CDS modeling data source.

fields.name: OrderLeadTimeDuration
fields.description:
Number of working days between the scheduled start date and the confirmed end date
(according to the factory calendar)

fields.name: OrderRuntimeDuration
fields.description: Number of calendar days between the scheduled start date and the confirmed end date

fields.name: NumberOfOrders
fields.description: 0 or 1. It is 0 if the maintenance order is deleted.

fields.name: NumberOfCompletedMaintOrders
fields.description:
0 or 1. It is 1 in the following cases:
Maintenance order is technically completed
Maintenance order has deletion indicator and system status
NCMP
(Not completed)
Maintenance order is a historical order

fields.name: NumberOfPlannedMaintOrders
fields.description:
0 or 1. It is 1 if the planning indicator of the maintenance order is 1
(Planned order).

fields.name: NumberOfUnplannedMaintOrders
fields.description:
0 or 1. It is 1 if the planning indicator of the maintenance order is empty
(Unplanned order).

fields.name: NumberOfImmediateMaintOrders
fields.description:
0 or 1. It is 1 if the planning indicator of the maintenance order is 2
(Immediate order).

fields.name: NmbrOfMaintOrdsNotToBeExecuted
fields.description:
0 or 1. It is 1 in the following cases:
Maintenance order has deletion indicator and system
status NCMP
(Not completed)
Maintenance order is business completed with no
technical completion date set

fields.name: NmbrOfOutstandingMaintOrders
fields.description:
0 or 1. It is 1 if the maintenance order has status Created or
Released.

fields.name: NmbrOfMaintOrdsCompletedOnTime
fields.description:
0 or 1. It is 1 if the Actual Finish Date and Actual
Finish Time of the maintenance order was before
or on the scheduled Basic Finish Date and
Basic Finish Time.

fields.name: NmbrOfHistoricalOrders
fields.description: 0 or 1. It is 1 for historical maintenance orders.

Internal or External Number RangeIf the maintenance event or revision has an internal
number range, this field is empty.

fields.name: MaintenanceEventTypeCategory
fields.description:
WPS ControlThe WPS Control determines how revisions or maintenance
events can be processed. The following are possible
values:
WPS-Controlled: A revision
type with this setting can be processed using the
Maintenance Event Builder.
Not WPS-Controlled: A
revision type with this setting cannot be
processed using the Maintenance Event Builder.
Planning Bucket: A revision type with this setting is used as
maintenance event type in the Manage
Maintenance Planning Buckets app.

fields.name: MaintenancePlan
fields.description: Indicates the unique identifier of a maintenance plan.

fields.name: MaintenancePlanType
fields.description: Indicates the type of a maintenance plan.

fields.name: MaintenanceItem
fields.description: Indicates the unique identifier of a maintenance item.

fields.name: MaintenancePlanCallNumber
fields.description: Indicates the sequential number generated by the system.

fields.name: Equipment
fields.description: Indicates the equipment that is in the maintenance item.

fields.name: FunctionalLocation
fields.description:
Indicates the functional location that is in the maintenance
item.

fields.name: MaintenancePlanningPlant
fields.description:
Indicates the planning plant that is in the maintenance
item.

fields.name: WorkCenter
fields.description:
Indicates the work center that is in the maintenance
item.

fields.name: MaintenancePlant
fields.description:
Indicates the maintenance plant that is in the maintenance
item.

fields.name: ABCIndicator
fields.description:
ABC indicator of the technical object in the maintenance
item.

fields.name: MaintenancePlanCallStatus
fields.description:
Specifies under which scheduling type the maintenance call is
found and the current status of that call.

fields.name: CompletionTime
fields.description:
Indicates the time in which the call object was
completed.

fields.name: CompletionDate
fields.description:
Indicates the date on which the maintenance was completed.
The date entered here is used as the basis for the further
scheduling of the maintenance plan.

fields.name: PlannedStartDate
fields.description:
Describes the time at which a maintenance task, for example,
a maintenance order is to be executed.

fields.name: MaintenanceOrderType
fields.description:
Indicates the key that differentiates orders according to
their purpose.

fields.name: MaintenanceOrder
fields.description: Indicates the key that uniquely identifies an order

fields.name: NotificationType
fields.description:
Indicates the key that enables notifications to be
differentiated and grouped according to notification
category, notification origin, and other criteria.

fields.name: MaintenanceNotification
fields.description:
Indicates the key that uniquely identifies the
notification.
